name: eval-viz
title: Eval window
description: One benchmark as a window: what it measures, the model's score and rank, then the leaderboard's rows entering in turn and their bars growing, the model's own row in red, and the benchmark's disclosure under them. VizWindow is the frame every product window shares.
use_for: Benchmarks and how it works on the website, while the band is on screen. `items`, `pick` and `runs` make it one window for several results that crossfades between them.
never: Running while off screen: set `active` only while it is in view

examples.label: On the site

props.name: title
props.description: What the bar says after the mark (Vue's `title` slot).

import { EvalViz, type Eval } from '@/react/components/visuals/EvalViz' // One benchmark's window as the website's benchmarks band shows it: the leaderboard's rows enter in turn and their bars // grow, the model's own row in red. Sample figures from the website's embedding benchmark. const vidore: Eval = { id: 'vidore-embedding', name: 'ViDoRe v3, embedding', description: 'Search over 19,252 business document pages with 2,419 questions in English and French.', metric: 'nDCG@10', better: 'higher', model: 'conare-embed-1', score: 67.0, rank: { n: 1, of: 9 }, rows: [ { rank: 1, name: 'conare-embed-1', value: 67.02, ours: true }, { rank: 2, name: 'Perplexity pplx-embed-v2-late-9b, page images', value: 66.48 }, { rank: 3, name: 'Perplexity pplx-embed-v2-late-9b, page text', value: 66.10 }, { rank: 4, name: 'Mixedbread search, page images', value: 64.24 }, { rank: 5, name: 'Mixedbread search, page text', value: 62.25 }, { rank: 6, name: 'voyage-4-large', value: 60.64 }, { rank: 7, name: 'gemini-embedding-2', value: 58.70 }, { rank: 8, name: 'voyage-multimodal-3.5, page images', value: 57.54 }, { rank: 9, name: 'BM25', value: 49.68 }, ], max: 80, disclosure: 'ViDoRe v3 was one of the benchmarks used to choose conare-embed-1. Perplexity\'s 9B on page images is level with it within the 95% interval.', } export default function Site() { return (
